text: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，1—6月，新发放企业贷款加权平均利率大约为3%，比上年同期低约20个基点；新发放的个人住房贷款利率约3.1%，与上年同期基本持平。
text_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that from January to June, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was about 3%, down about 20 basis points year-on-year, and the new personal housing loan rate was about 3.1%, roughly flat year-on-year.
